activity.notes: Berenice II married Ptolemy III at his accession and served as Ptolemaic queen and co-ruler during his reign. ATLAS records the secure 246–222 BCE co-ruling interval and ends this Activity with Ptolemy III's reign rather than extending the same office unchanged to Berenice's death in 221 BCE.

sources.title: Berenice II Euergetis (Ptolemaic queen and co-regent, 267/266–221 BC) — KBR SILVER
sources.citation_text: KBR SILVER identifies Berenice II as queen and co-regent of Ptolemaic Egypt from 246 to 222 BCE.

sources.title: Coin of Berenice II — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum catalogues this Ptolemaic silver coin with Berenice II as the ruler and Egypt as the minting place, providing direct material evidence of her royal status.
